conference.name: Attend Conference
conference.text: Choose one source in hand and present it as a conference paper. The card goes to your discard pile.

article.name: Publish an Article
article.text: Choose two sources in hand from the same era. Showcase one on your bookshelf.

book.name: Publish a Book
book.text: Choose four or more cards on one thesis: from hand, your bookshelf, or rivals' bookshelves (a citation).

research.name: Research
research.text: Draw 2 cards from a card archive.

network.name: Network
network.text: Discard n cards from hand. Take the next upgrade from a pile worth n or less; it replaces a card in your discard pile.

organize.name: Organize
organize.text: Remove any number of trash cards from your hand or discard pile. They leave the game.

travel.name: Travel Grant
travel.text: Draw 4 cards from a card archive.

society.name: Society Membership
society.text: Network: your discards count as n+1.

society2.name: Society Council Seat
society2.text: Network: your discards count as n+2.

assistant.name: Research Assistant
assistant.text: Draw 5 cards from a card archive.

press.name: University Press
press.text: Book needs only 3 cards and is worth 4 more prestige.

press2.name: Flagship University Press
press2.text: Book needs only 3 cards and is worth 7 more prestige.
